matchup.plan_md:
The user will not drop Saddiq Bey until Trey Murphy III is fully back, so Bey is locked. The free slots are Rudy Gobert's and Daniss Jenkins's. 6 adds are left.

| Murphy | Keep Jenkins (rotate Gobert only) | Rotate Gobert and Jenkins | Jenkins → **Toumani Camara** today, then 5 adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Back 18 Nov | 1,862 to 1,720 | 1,923 to 1,720 (Hyland first) | **1,921 to 1,720** |
| Back 20 Nov | 1,858 to 1,720 | 1,908 to 1,720 (Hyland first) | — |
| Out all week | 1,789 to 1,720 | 1,839 to 1,720 (Hyland first) | **1,836 to 1,720** |

**Move now:** drop Jenkins, add **Camara** (POR @MIN), before 12:00 PM Tue 17 Melbourne.
- **Why drop Jenkins:** every case gains 50–60 over keeping him.
- **Why Camara over Hyland:** the search's first pick is Bones Hyland, who has the same games (16, 17, 19 and 21 Nov) and is 2–3 points ahead. That gap is noise. Camara's starting minutes are steadier: 34.7 L7 against Hyland's 13.8 season, and Hyland's L7 is a 2-game small sample.

**Form:**
- **Camara:** rate 26.9. Season 25.8 (12), L7 31.7 (3), L15 22.0 (7), L30 25.8 (12). His L7 is +5.9, on starter minutes with Ja Morant out: Grade 2 hamstring, re-evaluated four weeks after 29 Oct ([Bleacher Report](https://bleacherreport.com/articles/25527343-ja-morant-injured-latest-updates-hamstring-strain-and-timeline-return-blazers)); *ESPN est.* 1 Dec.
- **Jenkins:** rate 32.9. Season 28.7 (12), L7 40.0 (3), L15 32.3 (6), L30 28.7 (12). His L7 is +11.3, on starter minutes until Jalen Duren returns. Duren's floor is 23 Nov; *ESPN est.* 24 Nov.

**After Camara, the plan follows Murphy's 18 Nov status.** NO files its report by about 10:00 AM Wed 18 Melbourne.
- **Murphy cleared:**
  - 20 Nov: Gobert → Grayson Allen, and Camara → Aday Mara.
  - 21 Nov: Allen → Brook Lopez, and Mara → Neemias Queta.
  - 22 Nov: Lopez → Mo Bamba.
- **Murphy out:**
  - 18 Nov: Gobert → Jerami Grant (MEM), by 12:00 PM Thu 19 Melbourne.
  - 20 Nov: Grant → Allen, and Camara → Derik Queen.
  - 21 Nov: Allen → Queta.
  - 22 Nov: Queen → Bamba.
- **Jerami Grant** (Murphy-out branch only): rate 26.8. Season 21.8 (12) → 23.6 (11), L7 31.0 (3), L15 25.2 (6). His L7 is +9.2 on unchanged minutes (22.7 against 23.7), so the lift is efficiency, not role.
- **Once Murphy has played a game,** Bey's slot can rotate too. Rerun the matchup then.
